title: I Paddle New York LLC
specs: Paddle calm, safe waters of Esopus Creek with no tides or barge traffic
See Cantine Falls, Saugerties Lighthouse, and Hudson River sunsets
Operator is ACA certified instructor and Red Cross certified in AED/CPR/First Aid
Minors must be accompanied by an adult
Minimum age 3 years and minimum 30 lbs for rentals; minimum 10 years old for single kayak rentals
Weight limit: single kayaks 300 lbs, double kayaks 500 lbs, SUP 250-275 lbs
Minimum age 16 years for sunset tours
No intoxication allowed; operator reserves right to refuse service
Tours generally have 5-8 participants; small groups preferred
Private tours available with minimum $300 charge

blurb: Guests paddle calm, safe waters of the Esopus Creek and Hudson River, enjoying nature and wildlife. Rentals and tours include lessons for beginners and are suitable for families and individuals. Various tours explore local landmarks like Cantine Falls and Saugerties Lighthouse, with options for private and group events.
extraNote: Rentals cancel 24 hours prior for full refund; tours cancel 3 days prior for full refund · Full refund if operator cancels due to weather · No refund for no-shows · No dogs allowed due to park rules · No paddling in thunderstorms or high wind; may paddle in light rain · Rental location: 61 South Partition Street, Saugerties, NY; Tours launch from Waterside Spa, 2 Ferry Street, Saugerties, NY · May through Fall
